3.narration_statement: The world your graduates will enter demands three kinds of readiness:
for 21st-century jobs driven by AI and complexity
and for entrepreneurship in markets that do not yet exist.
mySATHI measures exactly this — mapping each student's critical thinking, creativity, communication, and collaboration
against the demands of the future, not the standards of the past.
it creates actionable longitudinal intelligence that your faculty and counsellors can use to deliver student and university outcomes.
